How it works: SXM Bus does not depend on fixed bus stops. When you are near a mapped route, the app estimates the nearest approaching bus and suggests where along the route to wait.
Live ETA is an estimate based on the driver's GPS, route position, speed and your location. GPS accuracy and traffic can affect arrival times.
